t: That this Act may be cited as the “Federal Boat Safety Act of 1971”.

fable.w: This section is only a short-title provision naming the Act. It involves no federal decision and no consultation, hearing, rulemaking, advisory body, or right to sue involving any party outside the federal government. The only tempting reading is that the Federal Boat Safety Act as a whole contains participation mechanisms, but this section itself contains none.
